fixes.replace: The decision illustrates a pattern increasingly common in NCR disputes: an arbitration administered institutionally out of Delhi, with Delhi itself fixed as the seat, while civil disputes that fall outside the arbitration clause altogether remain anchored to Gautam Buddh Nagar under a jurisdiction clause expressly made subject to the arbitration agreement. Section 9 and Section 34 proceedings arising from the arbitration itself still follow the seat; in Anju Jain that means Delhi, not Gautam Buddh Nagar.
